notes: Tuition: the Regolamento Tasse page gives only ISEE-band tables and formulas and a general contributo onnicomprensivo unico range, not one amount for a non-EU applicant living abroad for Business & Management; the only figure that names the course (art. 6.1.2) is for services on request, not the general tuition. So tuition is left out.
